items.title: Arthur "Monk" Hazel Interview, 1959-07-16
items.q: the first one I know of that played saxophone was little George, young George Shilling

ctx.x: Did he have any saxes in the band in those days?

No, no. In those days there was only one saxophone player in New Orleans. He came here with a Mexican national band, a Mexican government band. His name was Remus. And he came here and although he was an old man at that time, he played with Tony Perranti. But when he originally came here, he was the only saxophone player in New Orleans. And then later on there was a fellow by the name of Dan Sanderson who played saxophone. But in those days, that's far back, they always used clarinets, no saxophones. But the, of…

Did you ever hear any more else, anything else about that old Mexican band, your father talked about it? You know, um, um, Jack Lane says his father bought some of the old instruments and some drums from that band for him and some old flags. That's how he got started.
